name: SilphNet
author: Ash
description: Log in with a name and password (get a unique Trainer ID too), add friends in-game by Trainer ID, and see their last-known positions as static map markers plus a friends list (online/offline, map, tile, time-ago). Every gym now has its own sign listing which of your accepted friends already hold that badge, and a league leaderboard sign near the Elite Four entrance ranks total league clears (ALL PLAYERS / FRIENDS, ascending or descending). Plain-HTTP presence reported every ~30s - no server process required beyond ordinary PHP+MySQL hosting. No live/real-time movement, no free-text chat by design.
